steps.what: Supervise assistants' work throughout the design process and clarify design directions

tasks.design: Retain assistant supervision with the designer. Existing design versions in {DOCS} support review; no separate progress chasing or minutes baseline is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: The designer must understand the assistant's work and resolve design ambiguity.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes reduced time for the supervision action.
tasks.still_hard: An apparently completed drawing may miss the intended user or manufacturing requirement.
tasks.human_edge: Give feedback that develops the assistant's judgement while protecting design intent.
tasks.altitude: Supervisory responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Guide an assistant through a physical design problem
reach.learn: How to explain design intent through concrete feedback

evidence.claim: Assistant supervision is contextual review and communication; no distinct reducible tracking baseline is established by this task.

assumptions: Boundary is assistant supervision, excluding assistants' actual design work and separate fabrication direction. Overlapping direction must be assigned once in a roll-up.

The designer supplies the brief before review. Assistants produce work and progress questions before or during s1; verification, feedback and instruction capture remain within its full time. No structured satisfactory-work flag is assumed.
Native design sharing precedes custom code. No new service or work transfer is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Assistant responsibilities and current supervisory scope
research_questions: Which design misunderstandings recur during assistant reviews?

approvals.approved_version: Exact assistant work version, review scope and design directions communicated; changed work requires renewed direction.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Supervision retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Design graphics for products and packaging

steps.what: Define the graphic material brief, surface constraints and permitted source assets
Design graphic illustration and ornamentation options for the manufactured surface

loop.input: Verified brief, permitted reference assets and surface constraints
loop.output: Editable draft graphic options with generation provenance
loop.check: Designer checks visual meaning, originality concerns, brand fit and whether surface placement misleads about the product
loop.stop: Two bounded option rounds then manual illustration; generated text or mandatory marks are excluded
loop.why_not_simpler: Illustration concepts require visual invention; templates suffice only for fixed placement and approved text

steps.what: Select, edit and accept the graphic material contribution

tasks.design: Use approved image assistance in {OTHER}, the graphic design application, for decorative illustration drafts. The designer specifies constraints, edits the selected graphic and preserves provenance; production artwork and print release retain their existing checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exploring decorative illustration directions required drawing each initial option.
tasks.enabler_now: Image generation can propose bounded draft options from a defined brief.
tasks.still_hard: A pleasing image may fail surface reproduction, originality or brand requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a visual direction that works on the actual product rather than only on a screen.
tasks.altitude: Less initial illustration effort where permitted; selection and production responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: How composition and material affect visual interpretation

evidence.claim: Adobe Creative Studio generates and edits images and attaches Content Credentials naming the system, model and time; this supports image drafting rather than production-ready packaging artwork.
The industrial graphic workflow and labour savings are an unmeasured local design.

assumptions: Boundary is graphic design contribution, excluding mandatory labeling authorship, dieline engineering, printing and physical application. Existing artwork specialist review remains unchanged outside this denominator.

In s1 the designer captures product and surface ID, dimensions, usable areas, required exclusions, brand constraints, permitted assets, intended visual meaning and source permissions. All capture and clarification occupy 30 hours. Unclear permissions or surface constraints require manual resolution; no structured rights-cleared or print-ready flag is assumed.

OTHER means the graphic design application. Test native image and placement features before code; preserve generation provenance. Manual illustration is the fallback when options fail or generation is not approved.
unknowns: Permitted image generation and source rights
Actual decorative illustration share and production constraints
research_questions: Do generated decorative options reduce drawing time after editing and surface reproduction checks?

already_counted.description: Brief, constraints and source permission capture

incremental.description: Generation guidance, provenance and exception upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact graphic file, product surface, placement, source assets, edits and provenance handed to artwork preparation; any change voids acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=30+24+30=84, gross=16, upkeep=7, net=9. Range 0-4 allows failed option rounds, originality review or graphics that require original hand drawing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Advise corporations on corporate image projects or problems through contextual review and discussion

tasks.design: Retain corporate image advice with the designer and client. Existing brand evidence in {DOCS} supports judgement; no separate proposal or image-generation baseline is established by an advisory task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Image concerns depend on the organization's behavior, audiences and business context.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes reduced time for the advice itself.
tasks.still_hard: A visual change may not address the underlying reputational problem.
tasks.human_edge: Question the brief and explain when an image intervention cannot solve a business issue.
tasks.altitude: Advisory responsibility and client decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the intended audience response to a creative project
reach.learn: How audience context affects creative recommendations

evidence.claim: Corporate image advice remains contextual judgement and client discussion; image-generation capability alone does not establish a reduction in advice time.

assumptions: Boundary is advice, excluding corporate strategy decisions, original research and creative production. Client approval and implementation remain unchanged outside focal time.

The client supplies the concern and brand evidence before or during s1; clarification, source assessment and recommendation occur within its full time. No structured reputation diagnosis or approved-strategy flag is assumed.
Native evidence sharing precedes custom code. No new service or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Advisory scope and available audience evidence
research_questions: Which corporate image concerns require business changes before visual changes are useful?

already_counted.description: Context review, client clarification and advice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. No separate proposal-writing share is invented.
